_design: Entries are matched by NORMALIZED key 'type/basename@version', NOT by exact uri. governance._vault_match_key() strips the leading '<plugin>.' prefix on both sides, so the 'global.' prefixes below are illustrative — a cap matches regardless of which plugin namespace currently owns it (drift-tolerant by design). Do NOT 'fix' these to exact live URIs; that would re-break placement (exact match = 0 hits). A few entries name caps not currently in the live source — they are harmless no-ops. High-sensitivity caps are intentionally excluded (kept private).
